session: Dev sessions (HS256 dev JWTs, users android-runner-a to -d) passed as debug intent extras (devSession=1, userId, role athlete, token, and displayName 'ada.runner@example.com' / 'bea.runner@example.com' for the account step), against the API in memory mode on the host (127.0.0.1:3187), reached at 10.0.2.2:3188 through a local proxy that logs every request, holds POST .../course/gpx-preview for 6 to 15 s on demand (to see the loader), and can drop connections. Offline: adb shell svc wifi disable and svc data disable (enabled again after). Relaunch: am force-stop, then the same dev session. A phone without the draft: a fresh read-only emulator boot, and later pm clear, then the same dev session. Animations off: settings put global animator_duration_scale, transition_animation_scale and window_animation_scale 0, set back to 1 after. Folds: cmd device_state state 0 (closed) and 2 (opened). Course and past-run files (course-50k-with-aids.gpx, course-50k-edited.gpx with one XML comment, corrupt.gpx, activity-long-trail.gpx) pushed to /sdcard/Download and picked in the system file picker. The memory API process died once mid-run (no error logged); user A's race went with it, so the rest of the phone flow ran on user B. The daylight saving check and the 429 ran on user B after the instrumented tests. Not run: Auth0 sign-up and sign-in (the dev session stands in for the account), TalkBack.

Course Continue sent nothing; the start time's Continue sent PUT /course once; history's first visit had the lead, the three tips, Import a past run and Skip. Phone without the draft (fresh boot): the history step; Back to the start time filled from raceStartAt; Continue moved on with no request; Back to the course: 'Course saved' and Continue, the race name 'Canyons 2027' read-only from the race list, no write.
